market_analysis.market_type_reason: The primary buyers are medical device manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, and healthcare packaging converters who purchase these technical materials for packaging and clinical applications.
market_analysis.market_definition: The Global Medical Films Market covers medical-grade films used in wound dressings (transparent film, foam, hydrocolloid, hydrogel and alginate backing films), vascular access and catheter securement, surgical incision films and drapes, negative pressure wound therapy, wearable diagnostic and monitoring patches (ECG, CGM, biosensors), high-durability medical packaging and ostomy / skin-interface films. This landscape compares the suppliers of the medical-grade polymers and materials these films are made from: thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) and other polyurethanes, polyethylene, polypropylene, polyester / PET, ethylene vinyl acetate, silicone-based polymers, polyamide and other medical-grade film materials, sold to medical film converters, medical adhesive and lamination makers and medical device makers.
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player produces and sells, under its own name, medical-grade polymer or elastomer materials (resins, compounds, TPU / TPE / silicone grades, film-grade polymers) used to make medical films -- including large diversified chemical and materials companies for which medical-grade polymers are one business line.
adjacent_segments: Medical film converters, extruders and laminators that buy the polymers (the customers)
Finished wound-care, catheter, drape, NPWT or wearable-device makers
Commodity polymer producers without medical-grade film materials
Distributors and traders of other companies' polymers

market_participants.definition: Companies that produce the physical medical-grade films, barrier laminates, and co-extruded structures under their own brand names.
market_participants.why_relevant: They are the direct producers controlling the material formulations, cleanroom manufacturing standards, and regulatory compliance required by healthcare buyers.

market_participants.definition: Companies that buy rollstock medical films to print, slit, or form them into finished medical pouches and bags.
market_participants.why_relevant: They act as intermediate structural participants that add value to the film before it reaches the final medical device or pharma OEM.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer is the chosen role because the competitive landscape is defined by companies producing and commercializing their own physical, medical-grade film materials rather than providing software or pure services.
